title: Tamperen Pyrinto conquer U19 League title
description: OBA - Pyrinto 71-76 OT Tamperen Pyrinto earned U19 League title. They nipped Omnia Basketball Akatemia in overtime to sweep the championship series. The guests took control from the first minutes by winning first half. But OBA won third quarter 23-18. However it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening, at least not yet. The game turned upside-down in the last quarter, where OBA used huge pressure winning it 24-15 getting a tie at the end of regular time. They lost eventually overtime period 6-11. Pyrinto forced 20 OBA turnovers. They looked well-organized offensively handing out 21 assists. Forward Arttu Pitkanen (194-2003) had a double-double by scoring 23 points, 11 rebounds, 4 assists and 4 steals to lead the charge for the winners and forward Roni Ahvenjarvi (197-2002) chipped in 19 points, 13 rebounds and 5 assists during the contest.
